description.text: Why choose to study this program? BUAA is one of the earliest universities in China which established Computer specialty. Computer software and theory of BUAA is the national key discipline. BUAA has considerable superiority in artificial intelligence, software engineering, architecture, virtual reality and multimedia technologies etc directions. It owns software development environment national key laboratory, the Ministry of Education virtual reality new technology key laboratory, and the Ministry of Education software on-line union R&D center etc research institutions. In addtion, BUAA built long-term cooperation relations with Microsoft, IBM, HP, Nokia, Motorola etc companies. Every year, at least 50 computer experts give lectures in BUAA. Main Courses and Credits Main research fields: including the computer science theory, internet-based cooperative working environment,software engineering and process engineering, grid computing technology, object-oriented software supporting techniques,system software and database, intermediates technology, mass information theory and methods. new internet architecture￡parallel and nework computing, and large-scale computer application projects Computer Architecture: high productivity computer system architecture, embedded and fault-tolerant computing￡grid system architecture, distributed computer system, integrated circuit design, airborne and space borne information processing. Course catalogue: In addition to the Common and Basic Courses, studens should take the main courses as follows: Course Title Hours Credits Semester Software Engineering 48 3 Fall Computer Network 48 3 Fall Artificial Intelligence & Applications 32 2 Fall Object Oriented Programming (Java) 48 3 Fall Digital Image & Video Processing 32 2 Fall New Technology of Computer Networks and Information Systems 48 3 Spring Data Structure 40 3 Spring Distributed Operating System 48 3 Spring Operating System 48 3 Fall Fees Tuition Fee Tuition Fee Insurance Duration CNY 42,000-45,000 / YrCNY 600 / Yr 3.5-4 Year Accommodation Fee No.1 Dormitory Two room apartment with a bathroom and kitchen 1,300 CNY/Mth. per room Da-yun-cun Dormitory No.10 BLDG Shared bed-room with a bathroom 550 CNY/Mth. per bed Single room with bathroom 1,100 CNY/Mth. per room Internship and Career Development School of Computer Science Engineer, BUAA has built some oversea bases to provide high-salary and high quality intership and employment opportunities for students. The graduates of BUAA are quite popular in software industry. Diploma Awarded Doctor's Degree of Engineering

duration.text: The Computer Software and Theory at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5833 USD/per year ￥ 42000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7. Financial support statement A certificate from the financial guarantor of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2.He/she must have a master's degree or have the equivalent educational background of a master's degree. 3.In general, the applicant should be forty-five years of age or under. 4.He/she must pass the entrance examination organized by the university. 5.He/she must be proficient in English and able to take courses in English or in Chinese.
